Casuarina Beach is in Karainagar, Jaffna District, Sri Lanka, about 20 kilometres (12 mi) from Jaffna. The 1.5 km long white sand beach is considered to be the best beach in the Jaffna Peninsula. The beach is named after the Casuarina trees that grow on the shore.
